description: Start a county filing for a property that qualified in check_property_tax_savings. Prepares the county's own review form and emails a signing link to the OWNER'S email address. The link is never returned here: the owner personally reviews, signs, and pays a flat $29 before anything is filed. Requires the continueToken from a qualifying check (valid 24 hours).

continueToken.description: The continueToken from a qualifying check_property_tax_savings result

ownerEmail.description: Owner email; the signing link is delivered there

ownerName.description: Owner name or names exactly as they appear on title

ownerPhone.description: Owner daytime phone with area code

rentedOut.description: Whether the property is rented out. Required for San Bernardino, Santa Cruz and Marin, whose county forms ask.

name: start_filing
